sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Not much is known about the tablet, except that it was owned by Jason, who had hidden it inside a stone chest alongside Madea's amulet at the basis of the Illusion Obelisk, on Madea Island.

After Zhalia Moon destroyed the Obelisk, the team inspected the rubbles and recovered the chest. While they deemed the Titan to be too unstable and sent its amulet to the Huntik Foundation for analysis, they kept the tablet to help them in their quest to find Jason's Argo. [The Beautiful Trap]

While they stayed on the island, Zhalia studied the illusion magic taught by the tablet and was able to learn Thoughtspecter. [Like Father, Unlike Son]

'''Jason's tablet''' is a stone tablet that pertained to the ancient seeker [[Jason]] and contained the secret to learning [[Thoughtspecter]].

== History ==
Not much is known about the tablet, except that it was owned by [[Jason]], who had hidden it inside a stone chest alongside [[Madea]]'s amulet at the basis of the Illusion Obelisk, on [[Madea Island]].

After [[Zhalia Moon]] destroyed the Obelisk, the team inspected the rubbles and recovered the chest. While they deemed the Titan to be too unstable and sent its amulet to the [[Huntik Foundation]] for analysis, they kept the tablet to help them in their quest to find [[Jason]]'s [[Argo]]. {{Source|The Beautiful Trap}}

While they stayed on the island, Zhalia studied the illusion magic taught by the tablet and was able to learn [[Thoughtspecter]]. {{Source|Like Father, Unlike Son}}
